input.summary: Full source-fidelity preflight (v10 functional-surface-geometry) completed against input/disclosure.md as the sole authority for invention matter, with input/brief.md used only for formalities (no priority claim, no federal sponsorship — both matching sections 02 and 03) and the truncated USER passage in input/conversation.md treated as duplicative of the disclosure's first three paragraphs. LEDGER: every limitation of independent claims 1 and 11 traces to affirmative disclosure text — plurality of connectors on one branch whose allowable aggregate current is below the sum of connector ratings; per-connector contactor, connector current sensor, control-pilot interface and local connector identifier; branch current sensor upstream of the connector contactors; stored charging authorization, requested current, minimum sustaining current and energy-deficit value; per-interval subtraction of measured non-charging branch load and configurable safety reserve; sustaining-first then deficit-weighted distribution; pilot delivery and connector-sensor verification; and shedding one contactor at a time in a stored shedding order after the branch current remains above the limit for a verification interval following a reduced pilot command. The reduced-command trigger in claims 1/11 ("responsive to the measured branch current exceeding the branch current limit") is entailed by "remains above the branch limit after a reduced pilot command" plus "staged reduction followed by ordered contactor shedding when branch current does not respond." Dependent claims 2/12 (re-measure after each opening, stop when below limit) trace to "until measured branch current is below the branch limit"; 3/13 to the three reclosure conditions; 4/14 to the welded-contactor leakage-threshold recording, inhibition of the other contactors on the same branch and local fault indicator; 5 to the isolated local bus carrying interfaces and contactors; 6/7/8/15 to the network interface, signed local authorization token and last accepted branch limit in nonvolatile memory, outage continuation subject to that limit and the independent branch-current safety process, token-authorized-and-unexpired gating of new sessions, and tamper-evident meter records uploaded on return; 9/10/16 to the service input, one low-energy pilot transition at a time, and storage of the association only after the sensed channel agrees with the commanded connector. NUMERALS: all 25 ledger entries (100–140, 202–216) appear in exactly one figure brief role and one description role, each denotes a single part throughout, every numeral used in a brief is described in section 08, and no described numbered part is missing from the ledger or the figures. FIGURES: FIG. 1 topology (branch conductor with in-line branch sensor, parallel drops to two connector channels and the non-charging load all downstream of the sensor, bus to the two channels only and not to the non-charging load, dashed sense line to the controller) is supported by "measures total current upstream of the connector contactors" and by the subtraction of measured non-charging branch load from the branch limit; FIG. 2 order supply→contactor→connector current sensor→vehicle connector is required by "connector current sensor reports zero" after opening and the leakage-threshold test; FIG. 3 network interface, nonvolatile memory and service input within the controller with an externally operated local fault indicator is supported; FIG. 4 step sequence, the 210 branch-current decision with return to 202, the 214 welded/no-welded split to a terminator versus 216, and the 216 return to 202 match section 08 step-by-step and the disclosure's process order. Shape choices expressly marked "shown schematically" (square contactor, circle sensor, rounded-rectangle vehicle, block outlines, dashed enclosures) stay confined to the figure briefs; section 07 and the description add no "by way of example," "any closed outline," or other shape-broadening embodiment language, and no untraced proportion, count, material, taper, depth, runout or contact-topology statement was found. INTERNAL CONSISTENCY: claims, summary, abstract and description use identical relationships and terms ("branch current limit," "last accepted branch limit," "connector channel," "control-pilot interface," "stored shedding order"); step names 202–216 are identical in the ledger, the FIG. 4 brief and the description; there are no section lines requiring matched designations; the abstract is 146 words; and no drafting note, placeholder, open question, instruction, unresolved alternative or internal comment remains in any file. Explanatory purpose clauses (staggered reclosure from the randomized recovery delay, sustaining-first rationale, welded-versus-shed discrimination, complete outage accounting) were each checked and are direct restatements of the disclosed features rather than added structure, relationships or results. Background prior-art characterizations were left to the later citation review as instructed. No untraced technical assertion and no verified inconsistency were found, so the findings array is empty.
